description.tr: Join us for an exciting trip to the İstanbul Teknopark Career Fair! Discover cutting-edge technologies and network with industry leaders as we explore a plethora of career opportunities in the tech world. This is a fantastic chance to see innovation in action and connect with potential future employers and collaborators. Don’t miss out on this opportunity to gain insights into the tech industry and advance your career. Sign up now to reserve your spot and be a part of this insightful journey!

location.tr: Teknopark İstanbul A.Ş., No:1 Teknopark Bulvarı, Pendik
